customers_say: Customers find the smart door lock to be of good quality and worth its price, with reliable performance and straightforward installation. They appreciate its ease of use, comprehensive features, and security capabilities, with one customer noting the anti-pry/tamper alarm adds real security. Customers like its appearance, with one mentioning it looks good on the door.
